hourglass.lore.common: Drops one last stubborn grain after time is up, so every argument about who won starts all over again.
hourglass.lore.uncommon: Pours its sand into a perfect little pyramid at the bottom, and refuses to be turned over until someone admires it.
hourglass.lore.epic: Leaked through a crack at the beach until the whole beach was inside its bottom bulb. The lifeguard is waiting for someone to turn it over.

i_band_aid.lore.rare: Sticks so hard that it held a torn kite together through a gale. Getting it off afterwards took the whole family and a bath.
i_band_aid.lore.epic: Came out of a giant box and stuck the whole playground together, swing to slide and slide to teacher. Break lasted until home time.
i_band_aid.lore.legendary: Patched a crack in the old town dam with one strip. The dam still holds, and it still has a cartoon dinosaur on it.

i_barometer.lore.rare: Taps its own glass until the needle points at Stormy, and the storm turns up to match. Mostly uses it to cancel PE.
i_barometer.lore.epic: Dropped its needle so far that the whole village tied down its washing, its bins and one very surprised goat.
i_barometer.lore.legendary: Pointed at Fair so stubbornly that a storm cloud gave up and went round the town. The next town over is still damp.

i_car_mirror.lore.rare: Folds itself in to squeeze through gaps narrower than the car. The car is far less sure about this.
i_car_mirror.lore.epic: Folded in every mirror on the street at once like a row of shy ears, and the bin lorry squeezed through the lane for the first time ever.

i_fire_screen.lore.rare: Catches sparks and throws them back into the fire like a goalkeeper. It has started shouting SAVE every time.
i_fire_screen.lore.epic: Glowed so cosily that the cat, the dog and grandad fell asleep against it in a row, and nobody could reach the fire to add a log.
i_fire_screen.lore.legendary: Blocked a spark the size of a football, spun it round and sent it back up the chimney. The neighbours thought it was a firework.

i_matchstick.lore.rare: Glues itself to other matchsticks overnight. The family woke up to a matchstick staircase leading straight to the biscuit tin.
i_matchstick.lore.epic: Was dropped into a jar of ten thousand toothpicks, and the family spent a whole week hunting for the one with the red head.
i_matchstick.lore.legendary: Was struck by a grown-up in a pitch-dark cave and lit it up so well that the bats asked for it to be switched off.

i_odometer.lore.uncommon: Has a trip counter that nobody ever resets, so every family holiday is officially four thousand miles long.
i_odometer.lore.rare: Rolls its numbers backwards whenever the car reverses. Grandad now drives home backwards to make the car younger.
i_odometer.lore.epic: Rolled over to all zeros on the motorway, so the car decided it was brand new and asked for its first service all over again.

i_plunger.lore.rare: Sticks to anything flat and will not let go: the fridge, the window, the dog's water bowl. Grown-ups now carry the glass table with it.
i_plunger.lore.epic: Pulled so hard on the bath drain that the whole bath came up instead. The rubber duck is still in it, on the landing.

i_tripod.lore.rare: Stands so still that birds land on it, a dog barked at it and a man tried to post a letter in it.
i_tripod.lore.epic: Spread its legs so wide on the busy pier that the whole queue for the ice cream van had to limbo underneath it.
i_tripod.lore.legendary: Held a camera still all night to catch the stars spinning. The photo shows perfect stars and one very confused moth.

mirror.lore.legendary: Copied its owner so well that the reflection went to school one morning instead. Nobody noticed until it wrote everything backwards.

i_oscilloscope.lore.rare: Draws the wiggly line of any sound and then plays it back wrong. It turned the head teacher's speech into a duck.
i_oscilloscope.lore.epic: Drew every voice in assembly as a squiggle, and the squiggles tangled so badly that the caretaker untied them with a broom.
i_oscilloscope.lore.legendary: Found the hum in a broken radio, then the hum in the fridge, then the hum in grandad. Grandad was just humming.

plastic_bag.lore.epic: Blew out of every bin in the car park and joined up into one giant bag that tried to carry the supermarket home.
plastic_bag.lore.legendary: Was reused so many times that it now goes to the shop by itself, picks the cheapest bread and comes home alone.

smartwatch.lore.epic: Buzzed every wrist in the cinema at the scariest moment, and the whole audience screamed at their own arms instead of the film.
smartwatch.lore.legendary: Talked its owner into ten thousand steps a day, then a hundred thousand. They are now somewhere in Scotland, still being buzzed.

toilet_paper.lore.rare: Rolls itself back up perfectly after the cat has finished, so nobody ever believes the cat did anything.

trash_can.lore.rare: Locks its own lid the moment the fox arrives. The fox now leaves angry notes on the doormat.
trash_can.lore.legendary: Ate so much at the street party that it burped, and the burp blew the bunting into the next street.

wall_clock.lore.epic: Fell off the hall wall, and every clock in the school stopped to look. Nobody knew what time it was until Thursday.

x_blinds.lore.uncommon: Has one cord that does everything, and nobody knows which way to pull it, so the slats spin like a fan.
x_blinds.lore.legendary: Tilted its slats so exactly that it spelled HELLO in sunlight on the living-room floor. The cat has slept in the O ever since.

x_curtain.lore.rare: Gathers every lost thing in the house in its folds: socks, keys, a whole birthday present. It hands them back only when it is washed.
x_curtain.lore.epic: Swished open so dramatically at the school play that the audience clapped, and the actors had not even come on yet.
x_curtain.lore.legendary: Blocked the draughts so well one winter that the radiators got bored and went on holiday.

x_french_door.lore.uncommon: Has two handles, and everyone tries the wrong one first, every single time.
x_french_door.lore.legendary: Opened so wide on the first warm day that it let summer in early, and the snowman in the garden asked to come inside.

x_front_door.lore.epic: Was painted on a hot day and held every party guest stuck to it like flypaper, so the whole party happened on the doorstep.
x_front_door.lore.legendary: Spotted the family car at the end of the road, opened itself, boiled the kettle and laid out the slippers. Nobody knows how it reached the kettle.

x_garage_door.lore.uncommon: Opens by itself whenever an aeroplane flies over, so the street always knows when the four o'clock flight is late.
x_garage_door.lore.rare: Rolls up so fast that it flings whatever is on top onto the roof: frisbees, footballs and once a very startled cat.
x_garage_door.lore.epic: Rolled up so fast that the car, the bikes and the paddling pool rolled out onto the road, and the street held a yard sale.
x_garage_door.lore.legendary: Rolled up so high once that it kept going, over the roof and down the other side. The house now has a garage door at both ends.

x_glass_door.lore.rare: Reflects so perfectly that the dog spent a whole afternoon barking at the dog on the other side. They are now best friends.
x_glass_door.lore.epic: Was polished so perfectly that a whole flock of pigeons queued politely outside it, waiting for it to open.
x_glass_door.lore.legendary: Was polished so perfectly that a goose walked into it, honked at it for an hour and has since adopted its reflection.

x_shower_curtain.lore.rare: Billows inward whenever someone sings in the shower, as if it wants to join in. It mostly wants the high notes.
x_shower_curtain.lore.epic: Let so much water out in one shower that the kitchen ceiling started to drizzle, and the dog downstairs got a shower too.
x_shower_curtain.lore.legendary: Kept a hundred printed ducks for so long that one of them learned to swim off the curtain and float in the bath.

x_shutter.lore.common: Bangs against the wall all night in the slightest breeze, like someone knocking to be let in.
x_shutter.lore.uncommon: Has slats that sparrows love to nest behind, so opening the window means meeting a dozen cross sparrows.
x_shutter.lore.rare: Slams itself shut faster than a wasp can fly in. The wasps have started booking ahead.
x_shutter.lore.epic: Slammed shut along the whole seafront at once, and the bang knocked every seagull's chips into the sea.
x_shutter.lore.legendary: Closed so tightly that it stayed night-time inside the house for a week, and the owls moved in for the holiday.

x_skylight.lore.epic: Collected so much snow on top that it all slid off in one go and buried the snowman, the car and the postman.
x_skylight.lore.legendary: Let in so much sunshine that the attic grew a lemon tree. The family now has the only attic in town with a harvest.

window.lore.common: Sticks shut on the hottest day of the year and swings open on the coldest night.
window.lore.epic: Opened in a gust that blew every school report out of the classroom and across town. Several parents have still not seen theirs.
window.lore.legendary: Steamed up so beautifully one winter morning that the finger drawing on it was hung in the town gallery. The gallery keeps a kettle beside it.

x_window_pane.lore.epic: Was hammered by hailstones so big that it caught one, and the family kept it in the freezer as a pet.
x_window_pane.lore.legendary: Survived a cricket ball, a hailstorm and a pigeon at full speed, and now wears a tiny sign that says UNDEFEATED.

x_bandage.lore.epic: Wrapped up a whole snowman during a game of doctors, and the snowman refused to melt until he felt better.
x_bandage.lore.legendary: Wrapped a wobbly old bridge in the park so tightly that it stopped wobbling. The ducks still use it every morning.

x_bathroom_mirror.lore.common: Has a light above it that hums like a bee every time someone brushes their teeth.
x_bathroom_mirror.lore.rare: Shows tomorrow's bed hair tonight, so everyone goes to bed in a bad mood.
x_bathroom_mirror.lore.epic: Steamed up so thickly that the whole family brushed their teeth by guessing, and grandad brushed his with the hairbrush.
x_bathroom_mirror.lore.legendary: Learned every song ever sung in front of it and released them as an album of foggy humming. Its biggest fans are toothbrushes.

x_beaker.lore.rare: Holds any amount without overflowing, so the class poured in a whole bucket and it still says 100 ml.
x_beaker.lore.epic: Measured so many things in one lesson that it measured the teacher, the hamster and the school pond. The pond came to exactly four beakers.
x_beaker.lore.legendary: Measured exactly one litre of thunderstorm, and the classroom has had its own small cloud ever since.

x_bidet_seat.lore.legendary: Pressed its own buttons all night and invented a new one, a tiny tune when the lid closes. Now the whole hotel wants one.

x_bin_bag.lore.rare: Grows a little bigger every time someone says 'just one more thing'. It now holds a whole broken deckchair.

x_binocular_strap.lore.rare: Swings its binoculars round like a lasso whenever a rare bird appears, so nobody ever gets to see the bird.
x_binocular_strap.lore.epic: Slipped open on a cliff walk, and the binoculars rolled all the way down to the beach, where a seal was found using them.
x_binocular_strap.lore.legendary: Held its binoculars so still for so long that a woodpecker mistook them for a tree and nested in the case.

x_binoculars_stand.lore.common: Points itself at the sky the moment your coin drops in, so you get ten seconds of cloud.
x_binoculars_stand.lore.rare: Zooms so far that it saw someone eating chips in France, and every seagull on the pier set off at once.
x_binoculars_stand.lore.epic: Swivelled round in a gust and showed the whole queue the inside of the ice cream van. The van sold out by lunch.
x_binoculars_stand.lore.legendary: Stared at the horizon for so long that it finally saw the edge of the world, and refuses to tell anyone what is there.

x_bonfire.lore.rare: Sends up a column of smoke so tall that the weather forecaster marked it on the map as a cloud.
x_bonfire.lore.legendary: Was built so cosy by the grown-ups that a pigeon nested on top, and bonfire night waited until the chicks could fly.

x_campfire.lore.legendary: Burned so cosily at the campsite that the tents shuffled closer in the night, and everyone woke up in one big tent pile.

x_chess_clock.lore.epic: Got its two sides muddled and made both players wait for each other all afternoon. Their pizza arrived, went cold and was eaten by the referee.

x_compact_mirror_case.lore.rare: Flashes sunlight into anyone's eyes across a whole playground. Uses it to point out spinach in people's teeth.
x_compact_mirror_case.lore.epic: Bounced the sun so hard off the beach that the lifeguard thought it was a shark signal and cleared the whole sea.

x_compost.lore.rare: Turns banana skins into soil overnight, so nobody can finish a banana before it has been composted.
x_compost.lore.legendary: Grew a pumpkin so big on its own that the family now uses it as a garden shed. The worms pop round for tea.

x_crumpled_paper.lore.epic: Unfolded itself in the bin and turned out to be the map for the school fair. The whole school dug through the bin to find the bouncy castle.

x_cuckoo_clock.lore.epic: Cuckooed so convincingly at midnight that a real cuckoo moved in and laid an egg behind the little door.
x_cuckoo_clock.lore.legendary: Popped its bird out so hard one noon that the bird flew off, toured the forest for a week and came back with a friend.

x_digital_alarm.lore.epic: Beeped so loudly through the wall that the neighbours got up, got dressed and went to work on a Saturday.
x_digital_alarm.lore.legendary: Woke up a bear at the zoo three weeks before spring. The bear now has its own snooze button.

x_door_handle.lore.uncommon: Is always on the opposite side to the one you expected, so everyone pats the door like a lost cat.
x_door_handle.lore.epic: Gave a whole office a static shock at once on woolly jumper day, and everyone's hair stood up for the team photo.
x_door_handle.lore.legendary: Shocked a passing thundercloud by mistake, and the thundercloud has kept away from the house ever since.

x_door_knocker.lore.epic: Was knocked so hard that the door next door opened instead, and the two families have swapped houses ever since.
x_door_knocker.lore.legendary: Knocked so loudly once that the whole house woke up and walked to the seaside. It came back sunburnt.

x_doorknob.lore.rare: Locks itself whenever someone says the word bath. Children have been using it for years.
x_doorknob.lore.epic: Turned the wrong way so stubbornly that the whole family went in and out through the cat flap all weekend.
x_doorknob.lore.legendary: Was turned so often that it unscrewed the whole front door, which walked off to find a quieter house.

x_dumpster.lore.rare: Swallows anything left near it, including a parked bike and a builder's lunch. It will not give the lunch back.
x_dumpster.lore.legendary: Was emptied so rarely that it grew a little roof garden, and the market traders now eat their lunch up there.

x_elevator.lore.epic: Squeezed in so many workers at nine o'clock that the doors closed on a tie, and the tie rode up and down all morning without its owner.

x_fire_pit.lore.common: Keeps one log that will not burn, no matter how many times the grown-ups turn it over.
x_fire_pit.lore.epic: Kept the November garden party so warm that everyone forgot it was November, and somebody got the paddling pool out.
x_fire_pit.lore.legendary: Glowed so warmly one winter night that the frost on the whole street gave up, and next door's roses bloomed in January.

x_fireplace.lore.rare: Blows its smoke back down the chimney whenever someone opens a window, so the whole room smells like a kipper.
x_fireplace.lore.epic: Warmed the house so well during the snowstorm that the snowman outside melted, walked in and asked to sit closer.
x_fireplace.lore.legendary: Burned one log so slowly that it lasted the whole winter. The log is now part of the family and has its own chair.

x_firework.lore.common: Comes in a box with a picture far more exciting than the firework inside.
x_firework.lore.epic: Burst into a shape so like a giant ice cream that the whole crowd went to the van at once, and the van ran out.

x_first_aid_box.lore.legendary: Patched up a whole football team, both goalposts and the referee's whistle in one match, and only ran out of lollipops.

x_first_aid_kit.lore.rare: Packs itself into every bag, so the family carried seven first aid kits to the beach and no sandwiches.
x_first_aid_kit.lore.epic: Unzipped on a windy hilltop, and the bandages flew off like streamers and wrapped up a whole flock of sheep.

x_flare.lore.rare: Burns underwater, which nobody believes until the fish start queuing to read by it.
x_flare.lore.epic: Lit up the bay so brightly during the drill that the lighthouse thought it had been replaced and switched itself off in a huff.

x_full_length_mirror.lore.epic: Tipped over onto the bed during dressing up, and the bedroom looked like it went on for ever. The cat is still looking for the end.
x_full_length_mirror.lore.legendary: Liked one outfit so much that it kept the reflection, and its owner has been wearing an invisible jumper ever since.

x_globe.lore.epic: Was spun so hard in geography that it flew off its stand, rolled out of school and was found two streets away, still pointing at Peru.
x_globe.lore.legendary: Spun so fast once that the real Earth noticed and joined in, and everyone got an extra five minutes of Tuesday.

x_grandfather_clock.lore.legendary: Grew so tall over the years that it now pokes through the ceiling and keeps the time for the bedroom upstairs too.

x_incense.lore.rare: Can make its smoke smell like anything, and it mostly chooses toast when everyone is hungry.
x_incense.lore.epic: Smoked so much at a tea party that the teapot disappeared, and the guests poured tea into the fog for an hour.
x_incense.lore.legendary: Drifted its smoke into such perfect shapes that it drew a dragon over the house, and the neighbours came out to wave at it.

x_inhaler.lore.rare: Gives a puff so fresh that its owner can blow out every candle on a cake from across the room.
x_inhaler.lore.legendary: Helped its owner blow up the biggest balloon at the school fair. It lifted the bouncy castle an inch off the ground.

x_keyhole.lore.legendary: Let a draught through so cold that the soup on the other side froze into a lolly. Grandma ate it anyway.

x_lab_flask.lore.common: Has a neck so narrow that every bottle brush gets stuck in it.
x_lab_flask.lore.legendary: Brewed a colour so new that the art teacher borrowed it, named it and painted the whole staffroom with it.

x_landfill.lore.epic: Slid a little in the rain and pushed the bin lorry back down the hill it had just driven up.
x_landfill.lore.legendary: Was covered in soil and trees and became the town's favourite park. The sledgers still find the odd teapot.

x_litter.lore.uncommon: Hides in hedges so cleverly that the litter-pickers walk past it every single week.
x_litter.lore.epic: Blew into the goal so many times during one match that the referee named it player of the match.

x_magnifier.lore.common: Makes everything look huge except the one thing you are actually looking for.
x_magnifier.lore.epic: Made one ant look so huge that the whole class screamed, and the ant had to be calmed down with a crumb.
x_magnifier.lore.legendary: Found a lost earring in the carpet, plus four marbles, a baby tooth and an argument from last summer.

x_magnifying_glass.lore.common: Makes the holder's eye look enormous to everyone on the other side.
x_magnifying_glass.lore.epic: Zoomed in so hard on a crossword clue that the letters ran off the page, and the whole family chased them round the table.

x_makeup_mirror.lore.epic: Lit up so brightly that the theatre forgot to switch on the stage lights, and the whole show was performed in the dressing room.
x_makeup_mirror.lore.legendary: Made one actor look so dazzling that the whole audience wore sunglasses for the second half.

x_match.lore.rare: Lights only for grown-ups. When a child picks up the box, every match inside pretends to be asleep.
x_match.lore.legendary: Was the only match that would light on a soggy campsite, so the grown-ups gave it a round of applause and its own tiny tent.

x_matchstick_fire.lore.rare: Burns in whatever colour the birthday child asks for, held by a grown-up, and it has never once been asked for beige.
x_matchstick_fire.lore.epic: Lit the barbecue so slowly that everyone ate the salad, then the bread, then the salad again.

x_microscope.lore.epic: Showed the class what was living on the school sandwich, and the whole school brought packed lunches for a week.

x_monocle.lore.epic: Glinted so cleverly at the fancy dress party that everyone took its wearer for a professor, and he gave an hour-long speech about cheese.

x_petri_dish.lore.legendary: Grew a mould so friendly that it started waving at visitors, and the school had to give it a name badge.

x_pillar_candle.lore.rare: Leans its flame towards whoever tells a fib, so the whole dinner table has gone suspiciously quiet.
x_pillar_candle.lore.legendary: Burned so calmly through a thunderstorm that the storm stopped to watch, and the whole town got one quiet evening.

x_porta_potty.lore.epic: Was delivered to the wrong field and became the most popular spot among the cows. They queued anyway.

x_portable_toilet.lore.common: Arrives on a crane, so the builders have to wait for the crane every time it needs moving.

x_potty.lore.rare: Hides itself whenever the toddler is not in the mood, usually behind the sofa with the remote.
x_potty.lore.legendary: Trained a toddler so well that he started training the dog, and the dog now gets a sticker too.

x_rain_gauge.lore.rare: Catches so much rain that it keeps the leftovers as its own private pond, with its own private frog.
x_rain_gauge.lore.legendary: Measured so much rain in one storm that the forecaster had to invent a new word for it. The word was BUCKETSPLOSH.

x_rear_view_mirror.lore.rare: Shows what was behind the car five minutes ago, so the driver always knows where the ice cream van was.
x_rear_view_mirror.lore.legendary: Bounced the sun so sharply into a speed camera that the camera took a photo of itself.

x_rubbish_heap.lore.common: Grows a new sofa on top every week, and nobody ever sees who brings it.
x_rubbish_heap.lore.uncommon: Has a pram, a lamp and a rocking horse sticking out of it, and the rocking horse rocks in the wind.

x_sand_timer_clock.lore.rare: Stops its sand whenever the tea is not ready, so every cup is perfect and every guest is very late.
x_sand_timer_clock.lore.epic: Timed the eggs so badly at breakfast that the eggs hatched first. The chicks are called Three Minutes and Four Minutes.
x_sand_timer_clock.lore.legendary: Was turned over so many times that it ran out of sand and started timing with sugar. Every cup of tea now arrives sweeter.

x_scented_candle.lore.rare: Smells of whatever you wish for, so the family all wished at once and the house smelled of pizza, roses and wet dog.
x_scented_candle.lore.epic: Was lit in every room for spa night, and the smells mixed into one so strong that the dog sneezed itself out of the door.
x_scented_candle.lore.legendary: Smelled so much like summer that the tulips came up in December to check. They went back down very cross.

x_skip.lore.epic: Was filled with every old sofa on the street in one weekend, and the neighbours climbed up and sat on it to watch the football.

x_snow_globe.lore.rare: Makes it snow in the room around it, but only on whoever shook it too hard.

x_soda_can_litter.lore.epic: Rattled down the high street on a windy day, and half the town marched behind it thinking it was a parade.

x_sparkler.lore.epic: Was waved so wildly by the grown-ups that they forgot how to stop, and the neighbours thought there was a disco next door.
x_sparkler.lore.legendary: Fizzed so brightly at the garden party that the stars blinked first and went to bed early.

x_sundial_garden.lore.rare: Moves its shadow to whatever time it likes, so in this garden it is always half past ice cream.
x_sundial_garden.lore.epic: Cast such a long shadow at sunset that the garden party thought it was bedtime and went home before the cake.
x_sundial_garden.lore.legendary: Told the time so confidently one cloudy day that the sun came out to check, and has never been late since.

x_syringe.lore.epic: Was so gentle at the school check-up that the loudest crier only noticed when it was time for the sticker.
x_syringe.lore.legendary: Gave a nervous elephant at the zoo its check-up so gently that the elephant asked for a sticker too.

x_tea_light_candle.lore.rare: Hops between lanterns when nobody is looking, so the lantern you just lit goes dark and the one behind you glows.
x_tea_light_candle.lore.epic: Lined the garden path so prettily that the hedgehogs used it as a runway all night.
x_tea_light_candle.lore.legendary: Lit a hundred paper lanterns at the river festival, and the fish came up to read the wishes written on them.

x_telescope.lore.rare: Sees so far that it spotted next week's weather and spoiled the surprise for everyone.
x_telescope.lore.epic: Was pointed the wrong way at the star party, and fifty children spent an hour admiring a very surprised owl.

x_test_tube.lore.uncommon: Has a rubber bung so tight that it shoots across the room when it finally comes out.
x_test_tube.lore.rare: Makes anything inside it ten times bigger, so the teacher keeps the cress seeds well away from it.
x_test_tube.lore.epic: Got mixed up with every other tube in the lab and made a smell so strong that the lesson finished on the playing field.
x_test_tube.lore.legendary: Held a sample of the sea so well that tiny waves still crash inside it, and seagulls follow anyone who carries it.

x_test_tube_rack.lore.common: Has one hole that is always a bit too small, so one tube has to stand on tiptoe.
x_test_tube_rack.lore.rare: Keeps every tube in alphabetical order, even unlabelled ones, and argues with the teacher about it.
x_test_tube_rack.lore.epic: Held every experiment at the science fair in one long row, and when one tube fizzed, the whole row fizzed in a wave.
x_test_tube_rack.lore.legendary: Held twelve tubes perfectly still while the whole sports day ran through the lab by mistake.

x_thermometer.lore.epic: Was so honest during flu season that the whole class went back to school, including the hamster, who had been faking.
x_thermometer.lore.legendary: Took the temperature of a summer heatwave and told it to go to bed. The heatwave left early.

x_toilet_cistern.lore.uncommon: Takes so long to refill that the next person waits outside humming the whole time.
x_toilet_cistern.lore.epic: Refilled so eagerly one night that the water came up the pipes and made the kitchen tap gargle a tune.
x_toilet_cistern.lore.legendary: Sang while refilling so beautifully that the neighbours recorded it, and it now has more listeners than the radio.

x_toilet_roll_holder.lore.rare: Hides the spare roll somewhere new every week, and only gives clues.
x_toilet_roll_holder.lore.epic: Spun so fast during one sneeze that the roll wrapped the bathroom like a cocoon, and the family had to snip its way out.
x_toilet_roll_holder.lore.legendary: Turned itself the right way round overnight in every house on the street, and ended a hundred family arguments.

x_toilet_seat_cover.lore.rare: Grows its fluff overnight, and by Friday the whole seat is lost inside a woolly cloud.
x_toilet_seat_cover.lore.epic: Was put on every toilet in the house, and the visiting sheepdog spent the whole holiday trying to herd them.
x_toilet_seat_cover.lore.legendary: Grew so fluffy that it was sheared at the farm show, and its wool knitted a scarf for every grandad on the street.

x_toilet_tank.lore.epic: Dropped its heavy lid with a bang so loud that the whole hotel came out in their dressing gowns for a fire drill.
x_toilet_tank.lore.legendary: Was jiggled once so perfectly by grandad that it never ran again, and grandad now offers his jiggle to the whole street.

x_torch_fire.lore.rare: Throws a shadow twice the size of whoever holds it, so every tour guide looks like a giant.
x_torch_fire.lore.epic: Lit the whole castle for the torchlight tour, and the suits of armour stood up straighter to be seen.
x_torch_fire.lore.legendary: Burned so brightly in the great hall that the castle ghost asked for a dimmer switch.

x_trash_bag.lore.uncommon: Has a drawstring that snaps the moment you pull it, so every bag gets tied by its own ears.
x_trash_bag.lore.legendary: Held so much rubbish that it was mistaken for a beanbag at the street party and sat on all evening. It held.

x_tripod_head.lore.uncommon: Has a handle that sticks out exactly where the photographer's elbow wants to be.
x_tripod_head.lore.rare: Turns so smoothly that it secretly swings the camera towards the ice cream van in every holiday video.
x_tripod_head.lore.legendary: Turned so slowly to film one sunrise that it filmed the sunset as well, and called it a very long video.

x_urinal_stall.lore.common: Flushes by itself whenever someone walks past, so everybody jumps.

x_wall_mirror.lore.rare: Shows the room as it looked this morning, so the tidied hallway always looks messy.
x_wall_mirror.lore.epic: Was used by so many guests checking their hair that by ten o'clock the hallway had run out of reflection.
x_wall_mirror.lore.legendary: Bounced the hallway light so far down the stairs that it lit the cellar, and the cellar spiders put on sunglasses.

x_wood_stove.lore.rare: Toasts bread through its glass door just by staring at it, so the toast is always ready before anyone wanted any.
x_wood_stove.lore.epic: Got so hot during the snowstorm that the snow round the cottage melted into a moat, and the postman arrived by canoe.
x_wood_stove.lore.legendary: Kept a mountain hut so warm that a family of marmots knocked every evening and asked to sit by it.
